plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24634
Victim is Quest Diagnostics (621511, medical laboratories), whose platform was accessed; Northern Light Health is a customer that reported no impact, so it is not listed as a secondary victim. Issue is not tagged Partner_Breach.
Asset S - Web application (Quanum Lab Services Manager, client-facing web platform). Hacking variety/vector Unknown (method not disclosed). Count not disclosed. Discovery date in the week of Oct 22, 2026; incident coded Oct 2026. Employee count Over 50,000: Quest has about 50,000+ employees; coded 50001 to 100000 (approximate).

summary: Quest Diagnostics reported unauthorized access to its Quanum Lab Services Manager platform, a system clients use to place test orders and retrieve results. Quest discovered the access in October 2026, disclosed it in a regulatory filing the next day, notified federal law enforcement and confirmed that certain patient records were accessed; the scope was still under investigation. Northern Light Health, which uses the service for nine hospital laboratories, said there was no indication its patient data was affected.
